dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: Greetings, Honorary Knight and the Helper in White. I'm not technically on duty right now, but I can't go home yet, thanks to this extracurricular project that Ematol has given me.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Basically, she's worried her record of your experience playing "Dodoco's Boom-Bastic Escapades" might not suffice, so she wanted me to take some extra recordings.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow! You two really are close, aren't you?

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: The way I see it, this is just a way of banking some credit so Ematol might actually feel guilty the next time she plays a prank on me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh, Paimon's not sure she actually will, but at least it adds another layer to your relationship!

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Oh, you think I'm taking it too seriously? People often say that my responses are a bit too by-the-book. Boring, even...

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: But I'm just trying to cut down on unnecessary communication so I can get some peace and quiet.

choices.text: Anyway, keep up the good work!

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Thank you, and have fun. Once we're done with all the recording, it'll finally be time for this cog in the machine to get some rest...
